heading: Test Yourself — Daily 5
subheading: Answer 5 UKPSC-style questions and get instant feedback. New questions added regularly.

questions.question: Which is the tallest dam in India, located in Uttarakhand?
questions.explanation: Tehri Dam on the Bhagirathi river is the tallest dam in India (260.5 m).

questions.question: The Kalsi rock edict in Uttarakhand belongs to which ruler?
questions.explanation: Kalsi (Dehradun) has the only Ashokan rock edict found in Uttarakhand.

questions.question: The Chipko Movement is most closely associated with which pair?
questions.explanation: Gaura Devi led the Reni village action; Sundarlal Bahuguna gave the movement national voice.

questions.question: Which article of the Constitution deals with the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.explanation: Article 32 — called the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.

questions.question: The state animal of Uttarakhand is the:
questions.explanation: Musk Deer (Kasturi Mrig) is the state animal; the Himalayan Monal is the state bird.
